The '''Palace Dragon Room''' was a holding pen located in the [[Government House (Sulon)|Government House]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]] that held a large [[Kell dragon/Legends|kell dragon]]. During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the fledgling [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kyle Katarn]] infiltrated the tower, fighting the forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as he went. Katarn eventually discovered the room, and upon entering it the kell dragon was released. After a duel, the beast was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Kyle Katarn]]. The room was made up of [[Color/Legends|gray]] walls and pillars, and had large windows on two of the walls. The kell dragon was kept in a small room protected by a large sliding door. The room could be accessed via a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Palace Dragon Room first appeared in the [[1997]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. The location went unnamed in the game but was identified in the game's [[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II: The Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]], which was written by [[Rick Barba]].
